shared_elements: standing human figures shown in profile
dense horizontal bands of script signs
figurative scene set above/beside blocks of writing
detailed patterned garments and elaborate coiffure/headgear
justification: Both show formally posed profile human figures in patterned robes and elaborate headgear confronting one another, one raising a shallow bowl/offering in an outstretched hand, combined with extensive registers of script filling the field below the figural scene. But the specific iconography differs sharply: A centres on a rayed sun-disc above an offering table with a royal pair and small attendants under an arched top, while B shows only two large near-life-scale figures, one with a fly-whisk-like implement and a dagger, with no celestial or altar motif at all.
